protocol.byteDefinition: CDP received network bytes including reported overhead; failed/unfinished transfers remain explicitly unresolved
protocol.scope: Main CDP session; service workers blocked; child-frame coverage incomplete; no network interception or request blocking
protocol.phaseMeaning: Cumulative totals in one context; deltas are additional bytes since the preceding checkpoint, not independent page loads

overallScore.label: Scoped WSG audit score
overallScore.formula: 100 * passed / (passed + failed + cantTell), grouped once per guideline

impactWeighted.status: Experimental project convention using WSG impact priority points; not a W3C site score

overallScore.interpretation: Passes satisfy only the declared scoped expectations; unknowns earn no points but are not defects. Compare only matching rubric, sample, and evidence profiles.

observations.scope: US government websites, 2025 analytics and December 2025 CrUX ranks

navigationPolicy: Failed document loads and HTTP errors have null chart metrics, unavailable headlines and no carbon rating. Raw responses remain in the source evidence. Legacy inputs without documentStatus retain their values with navigationStatus=unrecorded; this does not verify navigation success.

chartContracts.note: Cumulative totals: never stack phases; partial observations must remain labeled. Null values are unavailable, never zero.
Time-window increments, not causal savings. Keep independent branches separate.

chartContracts.aggregation: sum within a run and phase only
individual repetitions; median and range only for measured, completed, plausible counters
chartContracts.note: Whole-system CPU package; different browser/viewport from traffic phases. Do not add to SWDM.
Scenario point, not actual analytics or a confidence interval. Missing values remain unknown.
Display pass/fail/unknown counts and checked/total coverage; compare only matching rubric and sample. Not a conformance percentage.
Assumed page mix and rank-derived traffic; show partial-input status. Sensitivity cases are not confidence intervals; never add measured package energy.

annualFootprint.functionalUnit: One estimated year of page views at the audited origin, modeled operational and embodied browsing emissions
annualFootprint.notIncluded: Not a complete organizational footprint; no site-specific backend/build/office inventory or remote inference energy

assumptions.pageMix: Equal weights across sampled page URLs
assumptions.visitSelection: First recorded initial visit per URL
assumptions.traffic: Rank-bucket cohort estimate, not actual analytics
assumptions.sensitivity: All views at the minimum/maximum sampled page intensity; not a confidence interval or bounds on true site emissions
